name: Cat Burglars
desc:
Big loot. Little paws. Bring friends.
🐱 Become a cat burglar and rob a dangerous museum with your friends!
💎 Grab rare treasures—and team up to carry the HUGE ones.
🚨 Dodge lasers, sneak past guard dogs, and run from living armor.
🚐 Get your loot to the getaway van, then sell it back at your hideout.
One more treasure… or time to run?
